name: @astrolabe/desktop
description: Astrolabe desktop shell (Electron): starts the local server, serves the frontend, connects Claude, installs and updates itself on Windows.
author: Astrolabe

scripts.dist: pnpm run build && node scripts/stage.mjs && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: pnpm run build && node scripts/stage.mjs && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --publish never
